# paired-repo-parent-child

Provider: Grok Build. Version: Grok 1.0.3 phase0 fixture family; precise runtime stamp absent.

Origin: scrubbed repository capture excerpts.

Covers: multiplexed child rows, queue, spawn/progress/finish, parent-owned lineage.

Pairing: Repository files describe the same parent/child scenario, but excerpts are not byte-identical or a complete event-id match.

Known gaps: Expected items preserve each session scope. A parent view must select parent-1; child rows belong only to child-1. Source files provide different subsets.

Scrubbing: private prose, argument strings, paths, ids, model keys, and opaque data use neutral placeholders. Captured arrays keep at most three members. Hashes describe scrubbed input, not private source bytes. Only minimal excerpts are retained.
